items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: And he learned him how to play violin. And after he started playing violin, he got so that he started playing with Mr. Teton.

ctx.x: What did your brother start on? Was he older or younger than you? Oh, he's younger than me. One year younger than me. He was born...

He was born in... I was born in 1888. He was born in 1889. Remember the date of his birthday? On the... On the 15th of June. And I was born on February 2nd, 1889. 1888. 1888. And what was your first instrument? When did you start? The first instrument was the guitar. And when I was playing guitar, I was nothing but a kid, about 30, 40 years old. And we were ready to start with madeleine. And after he put out madeleine, he asked my dad and my mother to get them a violin. So he started learning violin from Mr.…
